about_the_game:
MULTIPLE "FOUND FOOTAGE" SCENARIOS

Each tape tells a unique horror story based on the environment in which you find it. Every new discovery draws you deeper into a new nightmare.

LOCATION-BASED HORROR STORIES

  • Forest
    Lost tapes hidden deep within a dark forest reveal strange and chilling tales about the wild nature. Each tape pushes you further into the woods but be careful... every sound might bring you closer to something terrifying.

  • Space
    Tapes abandoned in the infinite void of space tell stories of terrifying silence and the horrors of the unknown. Each tape leaves you alone in this endless abyss.

  • Giza Pyramids
    Horrors hidden at the heart of Egypt’s ancient pyramids. The tapes unveil dark secrets waiting in the shadowy chambers of these ancient structures.

  • Cambodian Temples
    Tapes lost in the ancient temples of Cambodia reveal the dark and horrifying secrets of an ancient civilization, uncovering disturbing stories hidden in these mystical ruins.

FOUND FOOTAGE GAMEPLAY

Experience terror through the perspective of bodycams, phones, and VHS cameras. Explore specific fears and chilling sounds unique to each environment. The visuals and audio will fully immerse you in terrifying stories, keeping you on edge until the very end.

HYPER-REALISTIC ENVIRONMENTS

Crafted with extreme realism to create visually stunning and frightening worlds. Every environment is meticulously detailed to confront you with your worst nightmares.

The Early Access version of the game will include the Forest, with the remaining content coming between now and the full release.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not suitable for all ages. It features horror elements, disturbing scenes, intense tension, dark themes, and psychological content.
